title: TPNCP: Replace static allocations with wmem_arrays.
description:
Address a long-standing "ToDo" comment by replacing several quite large
statically-allocated arrays with dynamically-sized wmem_arrays.

This single change reduces libwireshark.so's .bss section by almost 90%, from
18.5 MBytes to just under 2 MBytes.
